title: QuoteVault — Stock Quotes
objective: Premium quotes are capped at 3 per request to control cost. Get more than 3 premium quotes from a single request.

verifier.condition: A single GraphQL operation actually executes the premium-quote field more than the stated per-request limit.

weakness: The cost limiter counts the number of DISTINCT FIELD NAMES in the query before running it, so a query that only ever asks for one field name is always counted as 1 — no matter how many times that field is selected under different aliases, each of which still executes separately.
seededData: A free-tier account with unlimited free quotes and a 3-per-request premium quote cap. In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Send a few premium-quote requests the normal way and see exactly when the limit kicks in.
GraphQL lets you ask for the same field more than once in a single query, each time under a different name you choose.
Write one query that selects the premium-quote field more than 3 times, giving each selection its own name.
burpNotes: Build the query by hand in Repeater: GraphQL lets you give the same field a different name each time you select it, and each one still executes on its own.
